description: This file contains localization and language settings for the CKEditor 'a11yhelp' plugin in Simplified Chinese ('zh-cn'). It defines UI content, legends, commands, and keyboard mappings specific to this language, to be used for accessibility help within the editor.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: Sets the language strings for a plugin within CKEditor. Used here to define Chinese language localization for 'a11yhelp' plugin.
